title: Rhurho eDorobeni ra Khale
intro: Doroba ra khale leri nga ni ritshuri, vanhu va rona lava dzimeke timitsu eku kaneteni, ni xilemukiso xo hetelela lexi nga tekeriwaka enhlokweni. Namuntlha, nghena eka xiphemu xa lava rhumeriweke hi Allah ku yisa rungula eka vanhu vo nonon’hwa. Xitori xa ku ala, rito rin’we ra ripfumelo, na makumu lama funghiweke hi xileriso lexi onhaka. I mani loyi a vulavulaka hi swikombiso leswi?
clues: Hi rhumeriwe hi Allah edorobeni leri vanhu va rona a va fularhele ntiyiso
Vambirhi va hina hi tile ro sungula, kutani wa vunharhu a joyina leswaku a tiyisa vurhumiwa bya hina
Vaaki va le dorobeni va hi arile, va vula leswaku a hi nchumu handle ka vanhu vo fana na vona
Moya-xiviri wun’we lowu humaka emakumu ya le kule swinene ya muti wu tsutsumele ku ya byela vanhu leswaku va hi landzela
Hi va kombele, kambe va nonon’hwise timbilu ta vona, va hi hundzukela
Eka xirilo xin’we lexi onhaka lexi humaka ematilweni, muti wa hina hinkwawo wu miyetiwile

identity.label: Xana Ndzi mani?
options: Varhumiwa va Doroba eka Surah Ya-Sin
Va Hawwariyyun (Vadyondzisiwa va Isa) .
Valoyi va Huvo ya Faro
Vaseketeri va Savata
Vanhu va Ndlopfu
identity.answer: Varhumiwa va Doroba eka Surah Ya-Sin

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku ariwa no vitaniwa vahembi hi vaaki va doroba
U hisiwile a ha hanya hi ndzilo lowukulu lowu pfurhaka
Yi mitiwa hi nhlampfi leyikulu elwandle leri enteke
Ku sindzisiwa ku tirha hi matimba ku aka phuphu leyi tlakukeke
Ku xanisiwa ekheleni ra ndzilo lowu pfurhaka
trial.answer: Ku ariwa no vitaniwa vahembi hi vaaki va doroba

location.label: Xiphemu xa Nkoka
options: Doroba ra khale (al-Qaryah) .
Xigwitsirisi lexikulu lexi pfurhaka
Xitombo xa nhlampfi leyikulu
Nsika leyi tlakukeke leyi khumbaka xibakabaka
Yindlu yo kwetsima (Kaaba) .

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Doroba leri ri onhiwile hi xirilo xin’we lexi onhaka (Sayha) .
Mufumi wa tihanyi ni vuthu rakwe va nwile elwandle leri avaneke
Vanhu va hundzuriwile va va tindlopfu ni tindlopfu
Mpfula ya maribye leyi humaka empfhukeni yi lovise muti
Ndhambi ya tihanyi yi khukhule vaaki hinkwavo
outcome.answer: Doroba leri ri onhiwile hi xirilo xin’we lexi onhaka (Sayha) .

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
